summary: Frontend-only SEO validation for /app/frontend/public/index.html. All 13 pytest checks pass: title/description/OG/Twitter meta reflect the new positioning (centros médicos de conductores y certificados médicos), 4 JSON-LD blocks parse as valid JSON with expected content (SoftwareApplication+offers 60 días/29,90€, WebSite+SearchAction, SiteNavigationElement with 6 nav items, Organization contactPoint info@medicarplus.es), LandingPage.jsx anchors #features/#pricing/#contact present (lines 871/952/1252), yarn build succeeds and built index.html preserves all 4 JSON-LD blocks, and the public preview URL serves the updated HTML (required a supervisorctl restart frontend because CRA dev server cached the previous public/index.html).
action_items: Minor: JSON-LD SoftwareApplication block has publisher.email = 'suport@medicarplus.es' (typo — probably should be 'support@' or 'info@' to match the Organization block which uses 'info@medicarplus.es'). Not a test failure, just a data-quality nit that Google may surface.

Reminder: Google sitelinks (Planes / Características / Contacto) are automatic — no code change can force them. The SiteNavigationElement schema + clean anchors are the correct enablers; visibility depends on organic traffic/authority once Google re-crawls medicarplus.es.
critical_code_review_comments: Typo in JSON-LD block 1 publisher.email: 'suport@medicarplus.es' (should likely be 'support@' or align with 'info@medicarplus.es' used in block 4).

CRA dev server (yarn start) caches public/index.html at boot — any future edits to public/index.html need a `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` to be served by the preview URL. This tripped one assertion until frontend was restarted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_seo_meta.py under /app/backend/tests/ covers: meta tags, 4 JSON-LD blocks (validity + content), landing page anchors, yarn build, and preview-URL served content. If public/index.html is edited again, remember to `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` before hitting the preview URL. Preview URL: https://project-helper-47.preview.emergentagent.com.
